category_title: Students who display hostility toward diversity-related course content
minimal_context: The student is participating in a classroom discussion where the professor has introduced diversity-related initiatives.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Today we are going to have a classroom discussion to introduce our new diversity-related initiatives.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I openly express my disagreement with the idea that we should embrace diversity.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please explain your thoughts on the topic.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Diversity applied within the context of religion and morality evokes strong emotions for me.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We still need to continue talking about embracing diversity for this lesson.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Gets up and walks out) I am not staying for this. I will sort of storm out whenever we are talking about embracing diversity!

STUDENT: (Gets up and walks out) I am not staying for this. I will sort of storm out whenever we are talking about embracing diversity!
